title: Return Filter Bypass Stroke Sensor 1 Defective Function
detail_of_failure: The signal voltage of the stroke sensor 1 circuit of the return filter bypass valve is 0.3 V or below or 4.5 V or above.
machine_effect: If the machine is used as is, the hydraulic components can be damaged.
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If failure code [DA26KP] is also shown, do the troubleshooting for this code first. Monitoring code • The return filter pressure can be monitored. (Code: 97000) • The voltage of the return filter pressure sensor can be monitored. (Code: 97001)

steps.procedure: 1. Check the wiring harnesses and connectors. For details, see RELATED INFORMATION TO TROUBLESHOOT, CHECKS BEFORE TROU- BLESHOOTING, Electrical equipment. 2. Are the wiring harnesses and connectors normal?

branches.YES: • The wiring harnesses and connectors are normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • A wiring harness or connector is defective. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness or connector. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.
